name: LoRaWAN
summary: Read LoRaWAN uplinks from a ChirpStack v4 or The Things Stack v3 network server through its MQTT integration, and log them as a durable stream.

auth.label: Username and password or API key

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password or API key
fields.help: For The Things Stack, an API key. Read from a file that only its owner can access.

fields.name: client_key_file
fields.label: Client private key (PEM)
fields.help: A file that only its owner can access.

settings.name: broker_port
settings.label: Broker port
settings.help: Defaults to 8883 with TLS and 1883 without.

settings.name: ca_file
settings.label: CA certificates (PEM)
settings.help: Trust roots to use instead of the platform's.

egress.note: The network server's MQTT broker, on the port you set.

operators.summary: Read LoRaWAN uplinks from a network server's MQTT integration and log them as a stream.

implementation.evidence: unit and loopback tests; not run against a real broker, network server or device

notes: The Things Stack's MQTT integration is QoS 0, so uplinks sent while the bridge is away are lost. Gaps are detected by frame counter and counted, not filled; backfill through its Storage Integration API is not implemented (O-10 section 2.4.3, open issue 4).
